proposals.tactic:
intro k
induction k with
| zero =>
    intro m hm
    change Nat.factorial 2 ≤ 2 * m ^ 0
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.mul_one] <;> decide
| succ k ih =>
    intro m hm
    have hsmall : k + 2 ≤ m := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ (k + 2)) hm
    change Nat.factorial (k + 2 + 1) ≤ 2 * m ^ (k + 1)
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
    calc
      (k + 2 + 1) * Nat.factorial (k + 2) ≤ m * (2 * m ^ k) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul hm (ih m hsmall)
      _ = 2 * (m ^ k * m) := by ac_rfl

intro k m
induction k with
| zero =>
    intro hm
    simpa only [pow_zero, Nat.mul_one] using (show Nat.factorial 2 ≤ (2 : Nat) by decide)
| succ k ih =>
    intro hm
    have hstep : Nat.factorial (k + 2) ≤ 2 * m ^ k :=
      ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ (k + 2)) hm)
    calc
      Nat.factorial (k.succ + 2) = (k + 2 + 1) * Nat.factorial (k + 2) :=
        Nat.factorial_succ (k + 2)
      _ ≤ m * (2 * m ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul hm hstep
      _ = 2 * m ^ k.succ := by
        rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, pow_succ] <;> ac_rfl
